name: Woebot
one_liner: Woebot is an AI-powered mental health chatbot using CBT techniques to help manage depression and anxiety through daily conversations, with strong research backing from Stanford.
best_for: People who want 24/7 access to CBT-based support
Those who prefer chatting with an AI over journaling alone
People waiting for therapy access who want evidence-based support
Those learning CBT techniques who benefit from daily practice
People comfortable with AI-based mental health support
not_for: People in crisis or with severe mental illness
Those who find chatbots frustrating or impersonal
People seeking a replacement for human therapy
short_description: AI chatbot using CBT techniques for depression and anxiety. 24/7 support through conversational interface.
long_description: Woebot is an AI-powered chatbot developed by Stanford-trained clinical psychologists. It delivers Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques through daily conversations. Woebot checks in with you, teaches CBT skills, helps you track your mood, and provides in-the-moment support. Research published in peer-reviewed journals shows Woebot can reduce depression symptoms. It's one of the most evidence-backed AI mental health tools available.
patient_summary: Woebot is like having a pocket therapist that's always available. Chat with Woebot daily to learn CBT skills, track your mood, and get support for anxiety and depression. It's not human, but it's helpful and evidence-based.

pricing.notes: Currently free for consumers. Enterprise/healthcare versions may have different pricing.

privacy.notes: Developed by mental health researchers. Strong privacy practices. Data used to improve the service.

seo.title: Woebot: AI Therapy Chatbot (CBT-Based) | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Woebot is an AI chatbot delivering CBT for depression and anxiety. Stanford-developed, research-backed. Free. 4.7★ rating. Available 24/7.

faqs.a: Research published in peer-reviewed journals shows Woebot can significantly reduce depression symptoms. A study found that using Woebot for 2 weeks reduced PHQ-9 depression scores. It's one of the most researched AI mental health tools.

faqs.q: Is Woebot a replacement for therapy?
faqs.a: No. Woebot teaches CBT skills and provides support, but it's not a replacement for therapy with a human provider. Think of it as a helpful supplement - especially useful while waiting for therapy or between sessions.

faqs.q: How is Woebot different from ChatGPT?
faqs.a: Woebot is specifically designed for mental health with clinically validated CBT content. Unlike general AI, it's been developed by clinical psychologists, tested in research studies, and designed with safety guardrails for mental health conversations.
Woebot is currently free for individual consumers. The company has healthcare partnerships that may have different terms. The consumer app has been free since launch.

clinical_trials.outcome: Significant reduction in depression symptoms after 2 weeks of use

how_clinicians_use_it: Recommend to patients for between-session CBT practice
Provide 24/7 support for patients on waitlists
Supplement therapy with daily mood check-ins
Assign as homework for learning CBT techniques
clinician.implementation_notes: Consumer app without clinician dashboard. Recommend directly to patients. Consider for patients comfortable with AI who would benefit from daily CBT practice.
